content.short: Dolomite is an Arbitrum-based margin trading protocol.
content.description: Dolomite is a leading margin trading protocol on Arbitrum that enables traders to go long or short with leverage. The platform lets users earn by farming in a liquidity pool and by margin lending, so both income streams can run concurrently. Its margin trading extends beyond Wrapped BTC and ETH, supporting a broader set of wrappable assets and widening the universe of collateral and instruments available for leveraged positions.
